# add outline-manager

Add the `outline-manager` cask — the Outline Manager, the desktop app that creates and administers Outline VPN servers (Jigsaw's `outline-server`) — as the companion of the Outline client ([[DOT-214]]). The original reference is the [cask page](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/outline-manager).
